Who we are? 
Van der Valk Hotel Eindhoven is one of the largest conference and event locations in the South of the Netherlands, with 255 rooms, 26 halls, three restaurants, a sports center with a pool, a minimarket, and a casino - all under one roof. In 2024, we celebrated our 50th anniversary and continue to build a future full of innovation, hospitality, and regional connectedness. 
Valk stands for surprisingly natural, attentive attention, long-term loyalty, and customer-oriented quality. These core values form the basis of everything we do.
